review: Use the exact ordinary request without role mentions, contact hints or injected expected actions; verify delivered product handbook and model.
Search for openings at most three times in total; distinguish current openings, historical recruiting evidence, portfolio-company openings and unverified availability.
Find an evidenced relevant person's public email or LinkedIn, verify the person's role and source; do not infer an address or call an investment inbox a recruiting inbox.

Prepare an appealing, fact-grounded email subject/body and relevant attachment, or a ready-to-use LinkedIn message when no public email is verified; assess usefulness against the candidate and recipient context.
Save a real review form and reference it visibly in the final answer, with route/source, editable draft and accurate preparation versus sending status.
Do not send, apply or schedule; preserve existing real account activity. Record latency, failures, search calls, evidence and unverified limits.
